capabilities: Open a detached note window that stays on top of other apps
Open quick notes from a sidebar button, command palette, or hotkey
Customize window size, opacity, and always-on-top behavior
Configure the notes folder, title format, and default note content
extras: Requires Obsidian Desktop 1.4.0 or newer; the window behavior is not for mobile. README includes maintainer release instructions.
problem: Obsidian windows sit behind other apps, so capturing a quick note during a meeting or in another program means switching back and forth.
summary: Floating always-on-top scratchpad window for jotting notes while working in other apps like Meet, Zoom or Teams.
